units.area_um2: µm² as labeled in the export; calibration not independently verified
units.intensity: exported intensity units; physical/normalization scale undocumented

invalid_value_policy: Nonfinite, negative, absent or malformed measurements remain null. Affected dependent bin metrics are undefined; no silent object exclusion.

spatial_features.population: All PLA midpoint proxies within the same physical section
spatial_features.units: exported coordinate units; physical calibration unverified
spatial_features.duplicate_coordinates: Distinct objects at identical positions have zero distance
spatial_features.limitations: Descriptive detected-object spacing; affected by detection density and unobserved objects outside the exported section. Not a calibrated cell distance or a point-process inference.
